📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-29-methodsession-getaccountbysubdomain-nre`
This is occurrence #32 (cumulative total; degraded-mode DD-scan-diff cycle, no Slack MCP this session). last_notified_at was 2026-08-10T13:17:33Z — ~24h10m ago, 24h suppression window had expired.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm synthetic-only: ES aggregate message:'JWT Retrieval Failed' by fields.UserAgent.keyword — if 100% WindowsPowerShell and 0 real browsers, there is no customer impact. 2) Confirm the NRE stack trace: Com.Method.ServiceContract.Services.Account.MethodSessionService.GetAccountBySubdomain(). 3) Fix options: (a) CODE — add a null guard in MethodSessionService.GetAccountBySubdomain() (TFS-built Com.Method.ServiceContract, not in GitHub clones — route to platform-ui/MethodUI backend owner); (b) MONITORING — fix the Centreon synthetic check to send a valid account subdomain/Host header. 4) Until fixed, #alert-system will keep getting intermittent fires for this pattern — treat as monitoring noise, not a customer outage. [full playbook in kb/known-issues.json]
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status needs-human, 32 occurrences over 2.5+ months with no remediation
